name: Ref-YouTube-VOS
description: A dataset for referring video object segmentation, pairing video frames with language expressions that identify target objects. It is distinct from YouTube-VOS and is related to Refer-DAVIS. This record is metadata-only; no data is vendored.
citation: Seo, M., et al. (2020). Ref-YouTube-VOS: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Video Object Segmentation with Language Expressions. Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR).

license.identifier: Custom Ref-YouTube-VOS release terms (not a standard SPDX identifier)
